text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of a mock race. While 
watching from the stands, I spotted a 
familiar figure.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Couldn't even make top five, huh. 
Tch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sometime after that— I ran into Nakayama 
Festa by chance in town.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know that face. Hey, got a 
second?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Is there a shop around here—that sells 
knives?
choice_data_list: Wh... What are you planning to do!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...To peel apples, obviously. I came to 
visit my old teacher in the hospital... 
but forgot to bring a knife.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, she decided to borrow tools at 
the hospital. I watched from behind as 
Nakayama Festa bought some apples and 
headed toward the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Festa... you came to see me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You sent me another letter the other 
day, remember?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't... think of a reply. Felt like a 
pain, so I just came to talk in person.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Liar. That's not all, is it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ............ I lost. In a race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But... in that moment, all I thought was: 
Who cares? "None of this crap matters."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Reminded me of how I used to wander 
around aimlessly as a kid. And when I 
thought of that... I just really wanted to 
come see you, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
............ If that's the case, why don't 
we reminisce together? About the past.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...About when I was a brat? No way, that's 
way too embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
No. Something much more recent. That 
day... on the underground race track— when 
you challenged "the World".

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—A horse girl who made a name for herself 
across the globe. Intimidated by the 
weight of her name, not a single soul at 
the track dared to challenge her... 
except—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Racing Peer
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, cut it out...! You don't stand a 
chance against her...!

text_block_list.name: Past Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
Standing a chance or not... who gives a 
damn about that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Racing Peer
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? What are you thinking!? Just what 
are you doing this for—

text_block_list.name: Past Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I told you, you wouldn't get 
it.

text_block_list.name: Past Nakayama
text_block_list.text: —Because I want to "live".

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It's tough, but—in order for you to 
"live", ...doing things the same way as 
everyone else won't work.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You have to dive into a stage where you 
can burn your very life away. And that's 
something you have to find for yourself...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I know that already. Didn't need to be 
told.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A little while later, as I was getting 
ready to head back, I spotted Nakayama 
Festa once again.
choice_data_list:
...You look like you've got a clearer head 
now.

...You seem to have a much clearer 
expression now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Think so? ...Guess talking things out 
isn't totally useless after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...A stage where I can burn my life away, 
huh. If something like that were easy to 
find, nobody'd ever struggle.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Either way—I guess it means I just gotta 
go out and raise some reckless hell.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Nakayama Festa— sprinted 
off with tremendous speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a fierce ferocity that felt almost 
predatory, as if ready to tear into 
anything in her way.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Catch ya later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, Nakayama Festa walked away. —In 
her departing silhouette lingered an air 
of refreshing clarity, as if she had cast 
all hesitation aside.
